scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @infinite/attention && npm run build -w @infinite/remote
scripts.build: sh scripts/cloud-npm.sh 'npm run build -w @infinite/attention && npm run build -w @infinite/remote && npm run build -w @infinite/host && npm run build -w @infinite/web'
scripts.typecheck: sh scripts/cloud-npm.sh 'npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.type-tests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.mcp-exact.json'
scripts.test: sh scripts/cloud-npm.sh 'npm run build -w @infinite/attention && npm run build -w @infinite/remote && node scripts/run-tests.mjs'
scripts.check: sh scripts/cloud-npm.sh 'npm run check:size && npm run check:comments && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build'
